text:
The sixth overall pick of 2025 is looking for his first goal in 12 games. Porter Martone has 3 goals and 9 points in 25 games at about 14 minutes a night, and Broad Street Hockey ran "Porter Martone's slow start exposes a major Flyers roster problem." His coach is trying a fix: PHLY Sports' Charlie O'Connor reported that Rick Tocchet moved him off the Cates line to get him back to his natural right wing.

The drought is partly bad luck: his 12 goalless games came on 2.6 expected goals (the quality of his chances), he's shooting 8.6% against a league norm of 13.4%, and his teammates have scored 2.5 fewer goals than expected with him on. Philadelphia is also better with him on the ice at five on five than without, by about 6.6 points of expected-goal share.

NHL EDGE has his shot in the 84th percentile for speed but his skating ranks low. In Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking (only 9 games) he carried the puck in on just 30% of his entries. Our talent range puts his true rate around 2.1 points per 60, above his current 1.52.
